transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’ve just been feeling… really low. I wake up with this heavy, hollow sadness, like the lights are on in the studio but there’s no music in me anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… nine months, I think. It’s been there most of that time.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
I’m… not really sure. Some things feel different lately, but I don’t know how to explain it.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I still do things, I just don’t feel much from them right now.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in social activities or being around other people?
I’m not sure. I’ve been keeping to myself a bit, but I don’t know if that means I’ve lost interest exactly.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite?
Yeah… a bit. When I was kind of buzzing with ideas, I’d forget to eat, and lately food just doesn’t taste like much. My rehearsal clothes feel looser, so… I guess I’ve lost some weight.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns?
Yeah… it’s been pretty uneven. Some nights I’m up almost till morning sketching out formations, and lately I’ll crash but then wake up around four or five with my stomach all tight.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things?
Yeah… I do. I keep going back over the cancelled performances and thinking I let everyone down—the dancers, the funders, the community. People have been nicer about it than I probably deserve.
Have you had any thoughts about harming yourself?
I… don’t think so. Not really. I’ve felt awful, but I haven’t been planning to hurt myself.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or how quickly you move?
Yeah… I guess I’ve felt slowed down. Even just crossing the studio to grab my notebook feels harder than it should, like I’m moving through wet sand or something.
Have you experienced any strange or unusual thoughts, like hearing voices or seeing things that others can't?

A few times… when I was really wired, I thought I heard something. Like a low humming voice, sort of like wind over rock. It was telling me where the dancers should move, even when I was alone and the windows were closed.
Have you experienced any strange or unusual thoughts or perceptions recently, aside from the humming voice you mentioned earlier?

I guess… yes. For a while I was really sure the mountains were sort of… choosing me, like I was supposed to make this important piece. I kept reading things into trail signs, weather reports, even little comments from people, like they were instructions meant for me.
Are you still experiencing those strange thoughts or perceptions, like the mountains choosing you or hearing the humming voice?

No… not now. That was mostly during that wired stretch, when I wasn’t sleeping much and my mind was just racing through all these plans. Since I’ve come down… I feel guilty and slow, but I’m not hearing the voice, and I don’t really believe the signs are directing me anymore.
Have you had any periods in the last nine months where you felt completely back to normal?
Not really. I mean… the low part has been there, in some form, for about nine months. I don’t think I’ve felt completely normal for more than maybe brief moments.
Have you had any periods in the last nine months where you felt extremely happy, energetic, or irritable?

Yeah… there were stretches like that. I felt almost dazzlingly alive, like everything was possible. But I’d also get angry really fast if anyone questioned what I was doing, or reminded me my ankle still needed rest.
How long did those stretches where you felt extremely happy and energetic usually last?
It’s… hard to separate out. The whole pattern started after my ankle injury, and it’s been going on maybe two months now. The high stretches were kind of within that.
How long would these stretches of feeling extremely happy and energetic usually last?
I’m not sure exactly how long each one lasted. It all kind of started after my ankle injury, and the whole thing has been going on… about two months.
How many days or weeks would you say these extremely happy and energetic stretches usually lasted?
I don’t really know day by day. It’s more like… since the ankle injury, this whole pattern has been going on for about two months.
How many days would you say was the longest stretch you felt extremely happy and energetic?
I can’t really pin it down to a number of days. It started after my ankle injury, and the whole pattern’s been going on maybe two months now.
Did those stretches where you felt extremely happy and energetic interfere with your daily life or relationships?

Yeah… somewhat. I’m still showing up for the things I have to, but I fell behind on teaching prep, and I missed a grant deadline. My studio’s been kind of a mess too—people I work with have started handling basic scheduling for me. It’s not… how I usually function.
